why.en: The action is happening now, so we use is + -ing: the baby is sleeping.
why.uz: Harakat hozir sodir boʻlyapti, shuning uchun is + -ing: the baby is sleeping.
why.ru: Действие происходит сейчас, поэтому is + -ing: the baby is sleeping.

stem.en: Mum is in the kitchen. She ___ dinner now.

why.en: Now shows an action in progress: is + verb-ing (is making).
why.uz: Now hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi: is + feʼl-ing (is making).
why.ru: Now показывает действие в процессе: is + глагол-ing (is making).

stem.en: I ___ TV now. You can turn it off.

why.en: For something not happening now, use am not + -ing with I: I am not watching.
why.uz: Hozir sodir boʻlmayotgan harakat uchun I bilan am not + -ing: I am not watching.
why.ru: Для того, что не происходит сейчас, с I используем am not + -ing: I am not watching.

why.en: A present continuous question is Are + you + verb-ing: Are you listening?
why.uz: Present Continuous soʻroq gapi: Are + you + feʼl-ing: Are you listening?
why.ru: Вопрос в Present Continuous: Are + you + глагол-ing: Are you listening?

stem.en: My little sister ___ read yet. She is only four.

why.en: The negative of can is can't, and the base verb follows it without to.
why.uz: Can ning inkor shakli can't; undan keyin feʼl to siz, asosiy shaklda keladi.
why.ru: Отрицание от can — can't; после него глагол в начальной форме без to.

why.en: The short answer Yes, I can shows that the question uses can: Can you swim?

why.ru: Краткий ответ Yes, I can показывает, что вопрос задан с can: Can you swim?

why.en: After can, use the base verb with no -s and no to: can speak.
why.uz: Can dan keyin feʼl -s va to siz, asosiy shaklda keladi: can speak.
why.ru: После can глагол стоит в начальной форме, без -s и без to: can speak.

why.en: Can never takes -s: she can ride, not she cans ride.
why.uz: Can ga hech qachon -s qoʻshilmaydi: she can ride, she cans emas.
why.ru: К can никогда не добавляется -s: she can ride, а не she cans.

stem.en: ___ does the film start? — At seven o'clock.

why.en: The answer is a time (at seven o'clock), so the question word is When.
why.uz: Javob vaqtni bildiradi (soat yettida), shuning uchun soʻroq soʻzi When.
why.ru: Ответ — время (at seven o'clock), поэтому вопросительное слово When.

stem.en: ___ is that man? — That's my uncle Rustam.

why.ru: О человеке спрашивают Who; в ответе назван человек.

why.ru: Brothers and sisters можно посчитать, поэтому спрашиваем How many.

stem.en: Yesterday I ___ my grandmother on the phone.

why.en: Yesterday is past time, so the regular verb takes -ed: called.
why.uz: Yesterday oʻtgan vaqtni bildiradi, shuning uchun regular feʼlga -ed qoʻshiladi: called.
why.ru: Yesterday — прошлое время, поэтому правильный глагол получает -ed: called.

stem.en: Last summer we ___ in a small hotel by the lake.

why.en: Last summer is past time: stay + -ed = stayed (after a vowel, y does not change).
why.uz: Last summer oʻtgan vaqt: stay + -ed = stayed (unli harfdan keyin y oʻzgarmaydi).
why.ru: Last summer — прошлое: stay + -ed = stayed (после гласной y не меняется).

why.uz: Undosh harfdan keyin -ed oldidan y harfi i ga oʻzgaradi: study → studied.
why.ru: После согласной y перед -ed меняется на i: study → studied.

They watch a film last night.

why.en: Last night is past time, so we use the past simple: watched (not did watched).
why.uz: Last night oʻtgan vaqt, shuning uchun Past Simple: watched (did watched emas).
why.ru: Last night — прошлое, поэтому Past Simple: watched (а не did watched).
